STEP 1 - Scene: A roast-style meal with sliced pink (rare-to-medium) roast meat, roasted potato chunks, and sliced cucumber, served on a white paper/cardboard plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White square paper plate, roughly 22 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (11)² ≈ 380 cm² (the square plate is a bit smaller in usable area, so I use ~380 cm²). Food on the edge of the plate is part of this meal; there are no other plates visible.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Roast beef (pink, rare-medium slices, about 3 pieces)
- Roasted potatoes (golden, chunks)
- Cucumber slices (green, about 10 pieces)

STEP 4 - Area (share of the ~380 cm² plate):
- Roast beef: ~17% ≈ 65 cm²
- Roasted potatoes: ~25% ≈ 95 cm²
- Cucumber: ~10% ≈ 38 cm²
Total food coverage ≈ 52% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume (area × typical height):
- Roast beef: 65 cm² × 2.0 cm ≈ 130 ml
- Potatoes: 95 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 238 ml
- Cucumber: 38 cm² × 1.0 cm ≈ 38 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Roast beef: 130 ml × 0.95 ≈ 124 g
- Potatoes: 238 ml × 0.7 ≈ 167 g (chunks with gaps, dense starch)
- Cucumber: 38 ml × 0.55 ≈ 21 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Roast beef: 124 g × 200 kcal/100g ≈ 248 kcal (medium-rare beef, cooked)
- Potatoes: 167 g × 100 kcal/100g ≈ 167 kcal (roasted, lightly oiled, cooked weight)
- Cucumber: 21 g × 15 kcal/100g ≈ 3 kcal

Total ≈ 312 g, ≈ 418 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Half-covered small plate with a moderate protein portion, a potato serving, and a few cucumber slices. About 300 g and 400–450 kcal is plausible for this visible amount.
